newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: BANGLADESH TAKA RECOVERS ON STEADY DLR SUPPLY.
newsitem.headline: BANGLADESH TAKA RECOVERS ON STEADY DLR SUPPLY.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka edged up from the opening level in interbank trading on Wednesday as foreign banks offloaded U.S. dollars, dealers said.
The taka finished at 44.2000 per dollar against 44.2000/21000 at the open and Tuesday's close of 44.1950/1970.
"Selling by foreign banks kept the supply (of dollars) situation steady for the second day," a dealer said.
Interbank call money rates closed unchanged at 4.5 to 6.5 percent in a liquid market.
